theater: 紅魯塞尼亞與桑河上游

battle.name: 波蘭-韋萊蒂戰爭
battle.theater: 紅魯塞尼亞與桑河上游
battle.brief: 963年起，皮雅斯特王朝的波蘭與留里克系韋萊蒂公國為爭奪克魯維恩諸城與普熱米希爾，斷續交戰近二十年：978年波蘭奪下普熱米希爾，981年基輔的弗拉基米爾遠征而來，波蘭聯軍在桑河平原擊敗魯塞前鋒，城池仍歸基輔。卡面的羅馬標槍並非戰場實物，它代表的是結陣長矛兵。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 波蘭-韋萊蒂戰爭（一般斷代為963至981年，另有編年把981年後的爭端併入同一場戰事）發生在波蘭皮雅斯特王朝與留里克系韋萊蒂公國之間，戰場集中在紅魯塞尼亞：布格河與第聶伯河之間的克魯維恩諸城、桑河上游的普熱米希爾，以及穿過喀爾巴阡山口通往基輔與匈牙利盆地的商道。開戰一方是波蘭：米什科一世建立起以克拉科夫與格涅茲諾為核心的波蘭公國，軍隊靠名冊徵召的鄉土步兵與諸侯的私兵拼湊，國王親率大軍作戰，箭袋、斧與長矛是主力裝備，騎兵數量有限卻往往決定成敗；波蘭一方還拉上捷克與波希米亞的援軍，981年那一役更有德意志雇佣兵參與。另一方是韋萊蒂的留里克親王，奧列格與伊戈爾兄弟據特列博夫利亞與切爾文諸城，名義上向基輔的留里克大宗族稱臣；981年基輔大公弗拉基米爾親率大軍南下，奪走普熱米希爾並將這兩位親王殺掉，把韋萊蒂收編為直屬，再把自己的兒子斯維亞托波爾克與雅羅斯拉夫安置到當地。因此整場衝突也是波蘭與基輔兩股北方勢力，在喀爾巴阡山口與東加里西亞爭奪主宰權的一場角力。
countriesEn: The Polish–Volhynian War, generally dated from 963 to 981, with some chronicles folding the trouble that followed into the same conflict, was fought between the Polish Piast dynasty and the Rurikid principality of Volhynia, and the theatre lay in Red Ruthenia: the Cherwen towns between the Bug and the Dnieper, Przemyśl on the upper San, and the caravan road that crossed the Carpathian passes on its way to Kyiv and the Hungarian plain. One side was Poland: the Polish principality built by Mieszko I, with Kraków and Gniezno as its centres, fielded an army levied from the countryside together with the private retinues of the dukes; the ruler led the host in person, the backbone of the infantry was bows, axes and long spears, cavalry was scarce but often decisive, and Poland drew in Czecho-Bohemian auxiliaries, while German mercenaries fought on the Polish side in 981. The other side was the Volhynian Rurikid princes, the brothers Oleg and Igor, who held Terebovlia and the Cherwen towns and owed obedience in name to the Rurikid grand prince at Kyiv; in 981 Grand Prince Vladimir of Kyiv marched south in person, took Przemyśl, put the two princes to death, absorbed Volhynia into his own direct rule and posted his sons Sviatopolk and Yaroslav there. The conflict was therefore also a struggle between Poland and the northern power at Kyiv for the mastery of the Carpathian passes and of eastern Galicia.
people: 波蘭方面的關鍵人物集中在米什科一世的三個兒子身上。長子博萊斯瓦夫一世（綽號「勇冠」，Bolesław the Chrobry）自少年時便隨父出征，據編年傳記他在968年或978年已指揮大軍攻入韋萊蒂、奪下普熱米希爾，981年那一戰更由他收拾殘局；米什科於992年去世後他成為波蘭的實際統治者，1018至1019年再率軍攻入基輔。次子普熱米斯爾在975年征討捷克時陣亡。三子希維托佩爾克二世據說在979年前後陣亡於對普魯士人或魯塞人的戰事，波蘭隨即反擊普魯士並迫其進貢。皮雅斯特旁支的白萊謝克與茲比格涅夫兄弟在這場戰爭裡的角色最有爭議：加利西亞-沃里尼亞編年史《波蘭諸王事跡》說他們站在留里克親王一邊與基輔軍交戰，白萊謝克戰死；十五世紀揚·杜霍格的《波蘭史》更把細節寫成傳奇——白萊謝克在磨坊水道旁陣亡，血把水染紅，磨坊主後代因此記住此事。基輔方面的主角是弗拉基米爾大帝，981年他是主動出手的一方；他的兩個兒子斯維亞托波爾克與雅羅斯拉夫先後在基輔執政，並被派去接管韋萊蒂。留下同期文字的是梅爾澤堡主教梯特瑪，他的編年史是這場戰爭最可靠的同期記錄，也是唯一提到981年那場會戰的當代史料。
peopleEn: The decisive figures on the Polish side are the three sons of Mieszko I. The eldest, Bolesław I the Brave (Bolesław the Chrobry), campaigned with his father from boyhood, and according to the chronicles already commanded the host that entered Volhynia and took Przemyśl in 968 or 978; he was the man who settled the 981 affair. When Mieszko died in 992 he became the effective ruler of Poland, and in 1018–1019 he led an army into Kyiv. The second son, Przemysł, fell in 975 while campaigning against the Bohemians. The third, Świętopełk II, is said to have died around 979 in a war against the Prussians or the Ruthenians, after which Poland struck back at the Prussians and forced them to pay tribute. The role of the Piast kinsmen Leszek the White and Zbigniew is the most disputed of all: the Galician-Volhynian chronicle Gesta principum Polorum has them fighting on the side of the Rurikid princes against the army of Kyiv, with Leszek killed; the fifteenth-century Jan Długosz turned the story into legend, telling how Leszek fell beside the race of a mill and how his blood turned the water red, so that the miller's descendants remembered it. On the side of Kyiv the central figure is Vladimir the Great, who in 981 was the one who struck; his sons Sviatopolk and Yaroslav succeeded one another at Kyiv and were sent to take over Volhynia. The contemporary voice that survives is Thietmar, bishop of Merseburg, whose chronicle is the most reliable near-contemporary account of the war and the only source to mention the battle of 981.
kits: 卡面是羅馬標槍（pilum）：約一公尺八的直木桿，末端接半米出頭的軟鐵槍頭，桿與鐵頭的接合處做得脆弱，捅穿盾牌之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。波利比烏斯《歷史》第六卷描述軍團步兵的標槍長約六尺，偽希吉努斯《營寨設防論》記下木桿與鐵頭的分段尺寸，合計接近兩公尺；槍頭做成折彎的形狀，擲出時會顫動，砸在盾面上就留在盾裡。這件兵器在963年的波蘭或韋萊蒂營中沒有對應物，它代表的是另一種東西：結陣、齊整、靠長矛吃住距離的重步兵。波蘭方面的武備是皮雅斯特式的鄉土徵召兵：長柄矛（włócznia）、手斧與單手斧、圓形木盾，護具以皮甲為主、鎖子甲為輔；韋萊蒂與基輔方面是典型的東歐重步兵裝備：帶鼻樑的錐形盔（考古上歸為切爾尼戈夫型）、拜占庭工坊的鎖子甲（基輔型）、漆面圓盾、長身矛與輕型投擲矛，弓手用反曲複合弓並配箭袋（gorytos），近身戰靠雙手斧、彎刀與帶鉤的長柄斧，彎刀在東歐的考古中自十世紀起可見。騎兵是留里克親王的骨幹：鞍具已備高鞍橋與鐙環，戰馬披甲，衝鋒以密集楔隊針對敵軍暴露的側翼。攻城方面，基輔軍在981年圍困普熱米希爾，靠的是大型營壘與木構攻城器；983年基輔城下，帝國聯軍把駁船駛入第聶伯河，把塔架送上水面。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman pilum: a straight wooden shaft about 1.8 metres long with a soft iron head of some fifty centimetres at the end, the joint between shaft and head made deliberately weak so that the weapon breaks after it has punched through a shield, leaving the enemy to withdraw behind cover with half a weapon in his hand. Polybius describes the legionary's pilum in book six of the Histories as about six feet long, and Pseudo-Hyginus, in his treatise on camp fortification, sets out the separate dimensions of shaft and head, which together come close to two metres. The head was given a bent form so that the shaft quivered in flight and jammed in whatever shield it struck. This weapon had no counterpart in the Polish or Volhynian camps of 963; what it stands for is something else: close order, discipline, and heavy infantry that used the long spear to hold the enemy at distance. The Polish armament was that of a Piast levy raised from the countryside: long thrusting spears (włócznia), hand-axes and single-handed axes, round wooden shields, with leather armour as the main protection and mail in reserve. Volhynia and Kyiv fielded the standard heavy equipment of eastern Europe: conical helmets with nasal guards, classed by archaeologists as Chernigov type, mail of Byzantine workmanship in the Kyiv type, lacquered round shields, long spears and light javelins, bowmen with recurved composite bows and gorytos, the bow case, and, for the work at close quarters, two-handed axes, sabres and long-handled axes with hooks, the sabres attested archaeologically in eastern Europe from the tenth century onwards. Cavalry was the backbone of a Rurikid prince: saddles already had a high pommel and cantle, warhorses were armoured, and the charge went in as a tight wedge against an exposed flank. On the siege side, the army of Kyiv that surrounded Przemyśl in 981 relied on great camp works and timber siege engines; before Kyiv in 983 the imperial coalition put flat-bottomed boats onto the Dnieper and floated siege towers on them.
tactics: 雙方都沒有留下戰術條令，能拼湊出來的只有編年史的零星描述與考古痕跡。基輔軍的典型打法是先以騎兵分隊前出偵察，再以大隊快速通過喀爾巴阡山口的可行之路，避免在波蘭境內曠日久戰；981年攻下普熱米希爾靠的是圍城而不是正面決戰——那座堡壘是桑河畔山丘上的木柵、土牆與壕溝，圍城方以土壘與木塔逐步壓近，切斷它的水源與道路，再以衝撞槌與攀城手段收拾。波蘭方面的回應是把軍隊集中成結陣：密排的矛手與盾兵在前，弓箭手與投石手在後，騎兵兩翼護衛，待基輔騎兵衝鋒時以盾牆頂住第一波，再用長矛從縫隙間連刺；卡面那件標槍所代表的羅馬戰法——先以標槍洗盾、再以短兵收拾——正是這種「先消耗、再貼身」次序的教科書版本，只是十世紀的波蘭營裡沒有標槍，只有長矛與圓盾。981年桑河平原上那一戰，魯塞騎兵大概率先發動衝鋒，波蘭的矛牆頂住了第一波，魯塞人散亂之後波蘭聯軍（其中包括德意志與捷克的援軍）才反擊獲勝；梯特瑪記下魯塞人損失慘重、倉皇退走，戰利品中有從德意志運來的貴重貨品。真正左右戰局的是補給線：波蘭軍靠克拉科夫與普熱米希爾的倉儲度日，魯塞軍靠基輔與沃里尼亞的縱深、漁獲與鹽產，遠距離宿營、車隊與冬季牧養是決定勝負的變數；983年帝國聯軍在第聶伯河上放舟攻城，一場暴風吹散船隊、逼退大軍，也說明這個年代的戰爭多麼依賴天氣與糧秣。
tacticsEn: Neither side left a manual of tactics, and what can be reassembled comes from scattered notices in the chronicles and from archaeology. The typical Russian method was to push cavalry detachments out to reconnoitre, then move the main body quickly along a usable road over the Carpathian passes, avoiding a long exposure in the open country of Poland; Przemyśl fell in 981 by siege rather than by pitched battle, the stronghold being a timber palisade, earthen rampart and ditch on a hill above the San, which the besiegers closed in on with earthworks and timber towers, cutting its water and its roads before finishing it with rams and scaling. The Polish answer was to concentrate into a close-order formation: dense ranks of spearmen and shield-men in front, archers and slingers behind, cavalry guarding the flanks, waiting for the Russian charge to come in against the shield wall, holding the first impact and then stabbing through the gaps with the long spear. The Roman method the card stands for — wash the shields with javelins first, then finish them at close quarters — is the textbook version of that sequence of attrition followed by contact, except that the Polish camp of the tenth century had no javelins, only long spears and round shields. In the battle on the plain above the San in 981 the Russian horse most likely charged first, the Polish spear wall absorbed the impact, and once the Russians had been thrown into disorder the Polish coalition, which included German and Czech auxiliaries, counter-attacked and won. Thietmar records that the Russians lost heavily and fled in disorder, and that the booty included costly goods carried out of Germany. Supply was what really decided the outcome: the Polish army lived off the stores of Kraków and Przemyśl, the Russian army off the depth of Kyiv and Volhynia, its fish and salt, and the long marches, the wagon trains and the winter quarters were the variables that decided each campaign. In 983 the imperial coalition floated its siege craft down the Dnieper, and a storm scattered the boats and drove the great army back, which shows how completely warfare of that age ran on weather and fodder.
data: 這場戰爭留下的數字不多，而且中世紀編年史的兵數幾乎不可用：《往昔紀年》把981年基輔軍的兵力寫成數萬乃至數十萬，與任何可信的估算都對不上；較穩妥的說法是981年基輔出動的是一支混合部隊，核心是大公的親隨騎兵與各部落的武裝民兵，總數當在數千至一萬之間，敗於波蘭與德意志聯軍時損失慘重但未被全殲。普熱米希爾在981年與983年至少被圍攻兩次，每次都需要能支應數月的糧食。地理數字比較可靠：普熱米希爾在桑河上游，離克拉科夫約二百公里；克魯維恩諸城分佈在布格河與第聶伯河之間，橫跨約二百五十公里；由普熱米希爾到基輔約六百公里，途中多為森林、沼澤與山口。軍備可以量化：卡面的羅馬標槍全長約二公尺零六（木桿一公尺八、鐵頭約六十公分），重約一公斤半，每兵攜帶一束；十世紀的東歐長矛通長一公尺半至一公尺九，矛頭為葉形鐵葉、長約二十至三十公分，錐形盔重約二公斤上下，鎖子甲由直徑約八毫米的鐵環編成。考古樣本以奧希維奇姆附近的「千塚」最集中：墓葬數以百計，年代落在十世紀，出土基輔型鎖子甲與留里克式頭盔碎片，另有樹皮書信一件，是同期極少的文字材料。
dataEn: The war left few numbers, and the troop counts of medieval chroniclers are close to useless: the Primary Chronicle renders the Russian force of 981 in the tens of thousands, indeed the hundreds of thousands, which corresponds to no credible estimate at all. The sounder reading is that Kyiv sent out in 981 a mixed army whose core was the grand prince's own retinue of cavalry together with the armed levies of the tribes, a total probably in the region of several thousand to ten thousand men, which was badly mauled by the Polish–German coalition but not annihilated. Przemyśl was besieged at least twice, in 981 and 983, and each siege required provisions sufficient for months. The geographical figures are more reliable: Przemyśl stands on the upper San some two hundred kilometres from Kraków; the Cherwen towns lie between the Bug and the Dnieper across a span of roughly two hundred and fifty kilometres; the road from Przemyśl to Kyiv runs for about six hundred kilometres through forest, marsh and mountain passes. The armament can be quantified: the Roman pilum on the card is about 2.06 metres overall, a shaft of 1.8 metres with an iron head of some sixty centimetres, weighs around one and a half kilogrammes, and was carried in bundles; tenth-century eastern European spears run from one and a half to one metre ninety overall, with leaf-shaped iron heads twenty to thirty centimetres long; conical helmets weigh about two kilogrammes; mail is built from iron rings of roughly eight millimetres. The largest archaeological sample comes from the Thousand Mounds near Oświęcim, where the numbered burials fall in the tenth century and have yielded mail of the Kyiv type and fragments of Rurikid-style helmets, together with a single birch-bark letter, one of the very few written documents of the period.
cause: 三條線索纏在一起。第一條是地緣：從波蘭南部到基輔只有一條路，穿過喀爾巴阡山的幾個山口，而克魯維恩諸城與普熱米希爾正好卡在這條路上；誰控制它，誰就控制波蘭與匈牙利、拜占庭之間的皮毛、鹽、銅與穀物通道，這是波蘭王室的收入命脈，也是基輔大宗族向西南伸展的目標。第二條是王朝：留里克系的韋萊蒂親王奧列格與伊戈爾自視為克魯維恩的合法主人，基輔大公弗拉基米爾在981年重新收編韋萊蒂，等於直接否定了波蘭方面的依托；波蘭的皮雅斯特則早已把布格河上游與切爾文諸城視為自己的勢力範圍，兩者的地盤訴求在普熱米希爾正面相撞。第三條是信仰：米什科在966年受洗、普拉格主教區在973年前後落腳，波蘭走上拉丁禮；留里克系與拜占庭保持密切聯繫，基輔的弗拉基米爾也在988年受洗。教會版圖與經商路線在同一條河谷上重疊，戰爭因此帶上宗教較量的色彩——至少格涅茲諾與基輔的編年者是這樣寫的。直接導火線是981年基輔的遠征：弗拉基米爾藉口奧列格與伊戈爾不忠，出兵南下，殺死兩位親王、奪走普熱米希爾，波蘭不得不出兵救援，把一場邊境衝突推成了全面戰爭。
causeEn: Three threads are tangled together. The first is geography: there was only one road from southern Poland to Kyiv, through a handful of Carpathian passes, and the Cherwen towns and Przemyśl sat exactly on it. Whoever held them controlled the fur, salt, copper and grain traffic between Poland and Hungary and Byzantium — the revenue artery of the Polish ruling house and the target of the Rurikid grand princes stretching south-west. The second is dynastic: the Volhynian Rurikid princes Oleg and Igor considered themselves the lawful masters of the Cherwen towns, and Vladimir of Kyiv reabsorbing Volhynia in 981 destroyed the very title on which the Polish side relied; the Polish Piasts, for their part, had long claimed the upper Bug and the Cherwen towns as their own sphere, so the two territorial claims met head-on at Przemyśl. The third is faith: Mieszko's baptism in 966 and the establishment of the Prague bishopric around 973 put Poland on the Latin path, while the Rurikids stayed in close contact with Byzantium and Vladimir himself was baptised in 988. The ecclesiastical map and the trade routes lay on the same river valley, and the war therefore took on the colour of a religious contest — at least that is how the chroniclers of Gniezno and Kyiv wrote it. The immediate spark was the Russian campaign of 981: Vladimir marched south on the pretext that Oleg and Igor had been unfaithful, put them to death, seized Przemyśl, and Poland had to send an army to the rescue, turning a frontier quarrel into a general war.
impact: 短期看，波蘭輸了：普熱米希爾與克魯維恩諸城回到基輔控制之下，桑河上游的門戶關上，韋萊蒂則從一個獨立的留里克支系公國變成基輔的直屬領地，由斯維亞托波爾克與雅羅斯拉夫先後鎮守。對波蘭而言，這反而逼出了一條更西的路：與德意志帝國、波希米亞與匈牙利的聯盟越來越緊，983年奧托一世征基輔時波蘭與捷克的部隊就在聯軍之中；教會上與馬格德堡的往來也更頻繁，973年成立的普拉格主教區後來成為波蘭傳教團的基地。對基輔而言，代價是背上了一條長期不穩的前線：雅羅斯拉夫在1015年終於從普熱米希爾方向取回克魯維恩諸城，波蘭國王博萊斯瓦夫一世更在1018至1019年攻入基輔、短期戴上千金冠冕，直到1025年他死後雙方才回到拉鋸。更長遠的影響落在記憶裡：梯特瑪的編年史、《波蘭諸王事跡》與杜霍格的《波蘭史》把這場戰爭寫成波蘭與「魯塞人」第一次正面的碰撞，十九世紀以後又被拿來支持東來西往的政治論述，直到今天，波蘭的公共敘事裡仍留著「魯塞人」這個詞。
impactEn: In the short term Poland lost: Przemyśl and the Cherwen towns went back under the control of Kyiv, the gate on the upper San was shut, and Volhynia ceased to be an independent Rurikid appanage and became a domain of Kyiv ruled in person by Sviatopolk and then Yaroslav. For Poland the reverse effect was to push it further west: the alliance with the German Empire, Bohemia and Hungary tightened, and Polish and Czecho-Bohemian contingents stood in the imperial coalition when Otto I campaigned against Kyiv in 983; ecclesiastically, contacts with Magdeburg grew closer, and the Prague bishopric founded in 973 later became the base of Polish missions. For Kyiv the price was a permanently unstable front: Yaroslav recovered the Cherwen towns from the Przemyśl direction in 1015, and the Polish king Bolesław I invaded Kyiv in 1018–1019, briefly wearing the crown there, until after his death in 1025 the two powers returned to their long stalemate. The longer effect falls in the realm of memory: the chronicle of Thietmar, the Gesta principum Polorum and the Annals of Długosh wrote the war up as the first direct collision between Poland and the Ruthenians, and from the nineteenth century it was pressed into service in arguments about eastern and western orientation; the word Ruthene, in its Polish form, is still part of the public vocabulary.
result: 以軍力算，這場戰爭以波蘭退守告終：981年桑河平原上的會戰波蘭人打贏了，魯塞前鋒被擊破，梯特瑪記下死者與被俘者數量可觀，也記下波蘭人把部分魯塞俘虜交由德意志方面贖走，但城池最終沒有留在波蘭人手上，韋萊蒂的克魯維恩與普熱米希爾在983年之後確認歸於基輔；981年陣亡的白萊謝克更被後世寫成這場敗局的犧牲者，杜霍格筆下磨坊水道與被染紅的溪水，就是這段記憶最出名的畫面。體制上的結果是：留里克系在韋萊蒂的獨立性被終結，韋萊蒂自此成為基輔的西部邊區，基輔大公得以把勢力伸到喀爾巴阡山腳；波蘭則保住國土與王位，把爭取克魯維恩的目標推遲到下一代，並在1018年藉基輔內戰重新把它拿回來。軍事上還有一份收穫：波蘭人在這幾年裡摸清了從克拉科夫經山口到桑河的補給與行軍路線，也第一次以密集矛陣加騎兵兩翼的組合，在平原上正面贏過一次遠比自己裝備精良的東方騎兵隊。卡面那件羅馬標槍在這個結局裡沒有任何角色，它留下的是一條更耐用的道理：十世紀東歐的步兵靠的仍是結陣、長矛與盾，而不是任何遠方的異域兵器。
resultEn: Judged by arms, the war ended in a Polish withdrawal: the Poles won the battle on the plain above the San in 981, the Russian vanguard was broken, Thietmar records heavy loss of life and captivity and notes that some of the Russian prisoners were handed over to the Germans to be ransomed, but the towns did not stay in Polish hands, and the Cherwen towns and Przemyśl were confirmed as Kyiv's after 983. Leszek the White, who fell in 981, was turned by later writers into the victim of that defeat, and the mill race and the reddened stream in Długosz's account are the most famous image of that memory. In institutional terms the result was this: the independent position of the Rurikid line in Volhynia came to an end, Volhynia became the western march of Kyiv, and the grand prince could reach the foot of the Carpathians; Poland saved its territory and its crown, deferred the claim to the Cherwen towns to the next generation, and took them back in 1018 on the strength of the civil war in Kyiv. There was a military dividend too: over those years the Poles learned the supply and marching routes from Kraków through the mountain passes to the San, and for the first time beat an eastern cavalry force far better equipped than themselves in open field with a combination of a dense spear wall and cavalry on the wings. The Roman pilum on the card plays no part in this ending. What it leaves behind is a sturdier lesson: the infantry of tenth-century eastern Europe still stood on close order, long spears and shields, and not on weapons borrowed from a distant world.
